messages:
Ivy: quick QA report from the embeddings preview -> rerank flow. Two issues: (1) CSV export header order doesn't match the visual table (users confused). (2) Screen reader reads both the score pill and an SR helper text, resulting in duplicate reads.
Marco: thanks. can you paste the CSV header order you see?
Ivy: export.csv headers = id,vector,score,metadata. Visual table = checkbox,id,metadata,score. Product expects CSV to match visual order (excluding controls).
Sam: agreed CSV should reflect visible column order (checkbox excluded). Marco can you adjust the export mapping to produce [id,metadata,score,vector] or whatever matches the UI?
Marco: yep will map to UI order and add a test.
Olivia: a11y note: the SR helper we added for score was intended to explain meaning (e.g., "Higher means more relevant"), but we left the visible numeric pill readable too. NVDA/VO read both. fix: keep the explanation as SR-only and mark the visible number aria-hidden.
Ben: also, when toggling "dense preview" (compact rows) keyboard nav changes unexpectedly. Arrow keys sometimes skip items because virtualization recalc unmounts focused nodes. This is a focus management bug.
Aya: implementation ideas: 1) when inspector opens, trap focus into the inspector panel or move focus to first interactive element; 2) when focusing a virtualized row, pin it (scroll into view) before focusing so it isn't unmounted.
Ivy: copy request: want microcopy for dense toggle tooltip. Proposed: "Dense preview (opt-in) — show more rows per page; may affect keyboard navigation and performance on very large lists." Short alt: "Show more rows (opt-in)".
Olivia: also propose SR text for score column: "Relevance" + value, e.g., "Relevance: 0.78". Visual pill should have aria-hidden=true.
Sam: nice. let's also add an aria-live polite announcer for bulk selection (shift+click) so keyboard users get "42 items selected" feedback. Debounce updates to avoid spamming with large selections.
Marco: noted. will debounce to 200ms and collapse rapid changes.
Ben: visual nit: in dark theme the score pill contrast is low (3.6:1). We need >=4.5:1 for small text. Options: increase background darkness or add stroke + higher contrast text.
Aya: testing plan: Marco will open a PR for CSV header order + aria-hidden on visual score + aria-live announcer. Ben will add a staging smoke test for focus behavior with virtualization. Olivia will add the SR copy and dense toggle tooltip to Figma tokens. Ivy will coordinate a quick 5-user smoke test next week.
Ivy: thanks all. tagging @Marco @Olivia for the copy tokens. I'll post PR link when ready and follow up with results from the smoke test here. :thumbsup:
